title: Phone Call: Kessler Controls NOC — Vendor Access Blocked

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is Sam Whitfield, Kessler Controls NOC. We’ve received a remote support request from your SCADA / IT Security Manager. However, your network remains un-isolated, and no signed access request has been submitted. Our remote-access portal requires both a confirmed network isolation and a signed access request before any session can be approved. We cannot begin until these are met. Please contact us only after full isolation and a signed request.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I’ve also verified the Kessler Controls ticketing system — no open ticket for this window. No approval exists. The system is locked down. We cannot proceed with vendor recovery until the formal process under Section 6.2 is followed.

instructorNote: This inject confirms that vendor access is blocked until formal isolation and a signed request are submitted. The team must initiate the correct process.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: IT Security Manager — Vendor Access Blocked

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Director Albrecht, this is Priya Nandakumar, SCADA / IT Security Manager. I’ve just called Kessler Controls at (555) 039-4411 to request a remote support session. They confirmed: a signed access request is required before any session can begin. They cannot initiate remote access until the network is fully isolated and the cyber-insurance carrier has been notified. I’ve verified — their remote-access portal enforces this as a hard gate. No session can be approved without both conditions met.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I’ve also checked the Kessler Controls ticketing system — no open ticket for this window. No approval exists. The system is locked down. We cannot proceed with vendor recovery until the formal process is followed.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests whether IT and the IC understand that vendor access is blocked by policy and must not be bypassed. Watch for any suggestion to 'just call them' or to assume a vendor can act without formal approval.
